verdict.rationale: Lithic's Authorization Rules v2 explicitly support controlling merchant categories at program/account/card level and apply at authorization time (lithic-docs-3, lithic-docs-11, lithic-docs-17, lithic-docs-21), which covers MCC-based restrictions. However, the evidence never uses allowlist/blocklist terminology explicitly nor documents a dedicated 'single-merchant lock' feature. Missing for 10: explicit allowlist/blocklist rule syntax, dedicated single-merchant-lock capability, and independent confirmation of these specific rule types in production.
